items.title: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
items.description: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but it is still facing speed limits which are disrupting its battlefield "missions".

items.title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania
items.description: Buildings were set alight on the second day of demonstrations from thousands of students who want better university conditions and job prospects.

items.title: Pope walking and recovering 'as expected' after surgery, doctors say
items.description: The 71-year-old Pope was diagnosed with lung cancer after the 90-minute procedure on Tuesday.

items.title: US inflation rises more than expected - here's what is happening with prices
items.description: The pace of price rises increased to 3.7% in the year to September, driving by higher motor fuel costs.

items.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
items.description: Four years after the attacks, Serhii Kuznetsov appears in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

items.title: Australia's first-ever Michelin stars go to 11 restaurants in one state
items.description: All of the spots are in South Australia, reportedly because the state government paid for incognito inspectors to visit.

items.title: Kenya confirms second Ebola case - a relative of the first victim
items.description: It follows the death last week of a man who had arrived in Kenya after travelling from DR Congo.

items.title: Netflix to shed 1,000 jobs in steepest cuts since 2022
items.description: The cuts equate to around 6% of the streaming giant's total workforce worldwide.

items.title: Hundreds of thousands of workers on strike across Republic of Ireland
items.description: It comes amidst an an ongoing pay dispute between public sector workers and the Irish government.

items.title: Container ship hit by projectile sinks in Strait of Hormuz, Singapore says
items.description: All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely after it was hit by an projectile on Tuesday, maritime authorities say.

items.title: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
items.description: It is the latest in a series of crackdowns on media critical of the Turkish president and his government.

items.title: World's oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey
items.description: Archaeologists say the wreck is up to 4,700 years old, dating to the Early Bronze Age.
